subject: Portal onboarding: Vendr + OneTrust intake for Clearvest Payments
messages:
From: Aman Kapoor <aman.kapoor@clearvest.com>
To: Grace Occonnor <grace.occonnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearvest onboarding — Vendr / OneTrust intake

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. We're starting the vendor security onboarding for Clearvest Payments and want to get our profile live in whichever portal you prefer (Vendr or OneTrust). A few quick items to scope: 

- We have a draft SOC 2 Type II report (in progress; ETA mid-Dec) and a SIG/CAIQ fragment exported from our internal GRC. Would you accept an initial CAIQ fragment and follow up with the SOC2 when finalized?
- Preferred evidence upload method for Redwood: direct upload to Vendr, OneTrust collector, or S3 presign?
- Any required naming or manifest format for CAIQ fragments (CSV vs JSON)?

I've attached a short security summary and a preliminary SIG export. Happy to do a 30-min kickoff to walk through the manifest and SSO needs. Our security contact is me (aman.kapoor@clearvest.com) and I can loop in engineering as needed.

Attachment: Clearvest_SAAS_Security_Summary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Aman Kapoor
Head of Security Operations
Clearvest Payments
aman.kapoor@clearvest.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Grace Occonnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aman Kapoor <aman.kapoor@clearvest.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearvest onboarding — Vendr / OneTrust intake

Thanks Aman — welcome and congrats on the SOC2 progress. High level from our side: we typically onboard profiles into Vendr for questionnaire ingestion (SIG/CAIQ) because it allows us to run automated diffs and map evidence attachments. We do keep a OneTrust mirror for customers that require it, but Vendr is our preferred canonical intake.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- Day 0: Clearvest uploads CAIQ/SIG fragment + security summary to Vendr (or provide S3 presign).
- Day 1–2: Redwood runs initial mapping and flags missing evidence; we send a short ask list.
- Day 3–7: Clearvest provides missing artifacts (presigned S3 or direct upload).
- Post-SOC2: upload final report; Redwood will attach report to the profile and mark SOC2 completed.

Practical asks now:
1) Can you create a dedicated upload account (portal-uploader@clearvest.com) or let us presign an S3 bucket for a one-time ingest? We prefer presign for large bundles.
2) CAIQ fragments are fine in CSV or JSON; the filename pattern we ingest is: clearvest_caig_fragment_YYYYMMDD.{csv|json}.
3) Please include a short mapping file that shows control-level evidence mapping if possible (a simple two-column CSV is fine).

I've attached our onboarding checklist that includes fields we need for role mapping and SSO (SAML metadata or OIDC client). Jonas — can you outline the technical steps we need to run the ingest and the minimal SSO claims we require?

If that looks ok, Aman, can you share a few times tomorrow (30-min) for a kickoff? We can include Marissa to coordinate contract/procurement awareness if any portal fees or DPA addenda are needed.

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Grace Occonnor
Sr. Security Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aman Kapoor <aman.kapoor@clearvest.com>, Grace Occonnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearvest onboarding — Vendr / OneTrust intake

Thanks Grace — technical details from infra side. Aman, copying the steps here so your engineers have a checklist: 

1) Vendr ingestion: we can import CAIQ/SIG fragments via the Vendr API or by S3. If you want API, generate an API key scoped to "questionnaire:write" and share it via a secure channel (we can provide a temporary key upload link). Example curl for import: 

  curl -X POST \"https://api.vendr.io/v1/profiles/import\" 
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer <VENDR_API_KEY>\" 
    -F \"file=@clearvest_SIG_fragment.csv\" 
    -F \"format=caiaq\"

2) S3 presign option: we can give you a presign endpoint (expires 24 hours) and we ingest directly into our staging bucket. If you choose presign, please upload a manifest.json listing file names and expected control mappings.

3) SSO: for SAML metadata we need: EntityID, ACS URL, NameID format, and claims for email + groups. OIDC: client_id, redirect_uris, and a jwks endpoint. For OIDC we prefer the email claim to be included as a verified claim.

4) Evidence format: PDF, TXT, CSV acceptable. For CAIQ fragments we accept either columnar CSV with control IDs (e.g., CAIQ-1.1.1) or standard CAIQ JSON. If you send an initial fragment, we will run a parse and return a mapping report.

Related: I opened a Jira ticket for tracking (SEC-4123) and uploaded a minimal ingestion template to the doc above. If you prefer, we can do the initial ingest on a test profile before publicizing it.

Let us know which route you prefer (API vs S3) and I'll provision the upload artifacts.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aman Kapoor <aman.kapoor@clearvest.com>
To: Grace Occonnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearvest onboarding — Vendr / OneTrust intake

Perfect — thanks both. We'll proceed with S3 presign for the initial bulk (our bundle is ~120MB). I've attached a trimmed SIG fragment and a contact CSV for uploads. Next steps from Clearvest: 

- I will provision portal-uploader@clearvest.com tomorrow and share the account MR via secure link.
- We'll upload clearvest_SIG_fragment.csv to the presign URL once you provide it; please send the presign endpoint and manifest template.
- For SSO, we can provide SAML metadata next week (EntityID & ACS URL) — engineering is on that.

Available slots for a 30-min kickoff: Fri 11/7 10:00-10:30 PT, Mon 11/10 09:30-10:00 PT. Let me know which works and we'll confirm.

Attachments: clearvest_SIG_fragment.csv (csv)

Thanks,
